messages:
anna: Quick heads-up — planning to bump service to v2.4.1-rc today. Cutoff for non-hotfix changes 18:00 PT. Need green CI sweep + a tiny changelog blurb. Please ack.

sam: Ack. I'll queue a smoke sweep now and ping reviewers.

deploy-bot: build-queue: Job 78912 enqueued for branch release/v2.4.1-rc (triggered by @sam)

qa-bot: test-monitor: flake detector caught intermittent failure in integration/auth.test on macos-latest (3/10 runs flaky)

mika: Noted. I can triage auth.test — suspect timer/race with token refresh. Will run reproducer.

ben: I'll take review rotations 12:00-14:00 PT. Assigning myself to the bump PR.

luis: Are we lifting branch freeze for the bump? There's a candidate hotfix in feature/hotfix-logging.

anna: No freeze lift — only the bump and changelog. If hotfix is required, open a separate PR and ping me.

sam: Smoke sweep started: 
```bash
scripts/ci/smoke-sweep.sh --jobs=20 --timeout=30m
```
Results will post here.

deploy-bot: build-update: Job 78912 started on runner-gpu-8

ben: Reproducer run: 
```bash
yarn jest integration/auth.test -t 'token refresh' --runInBand
```
Local pass x3, will run matrix.

mika: Found flakiness: test waits for 200ms sometimes returns 180ms on CI — bumping timeout to 500ms in test to see.

sam: Cool. Once CI is green, please add changelog snippet: one-liner and link to PR. Example: "Fix: token refresh hang under heavy load (ben)". Keep it brief.

ben: Added changelog draft to PR description. Pinged reviewers: @mika @luis

luis: LGTM for changelog text. +1 on the small timeout bump.

qa-bot: smoke-sweep report: 18/20 jobs passed, 2 failed (integration/auth.test flaky), rerun queued.

anna: Thanks everyone — if rerun is green by 17:30 PT we can cut the RC tag. I'll do a final rollcall at 17:40 PT.

sam: Will monitor and post final status. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: build-update: Job 78912 completed — All checks passed (including reruns).
